During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the popular '''governor''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tandankin]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]], leading the various ethnic factions of the world to blame each other for the crime.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Investigation|Death of a Statesman}}</ref>
